exposure: experience of 2 or more prior uterine curettage
short cervical length before delivery (<2.0 cm)
incomplete placenta previa located on the posterior uterine wall
cohort: 210 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies complicated by incomplete placenta previa located on the posterior uterine wall who underwent elective or emergency cesarean section after 24 weeks of gestation
finding: In women with incomplete placenta previa located on the posterior uterine wall, a history of 2 or more prior uterine curettages, short cervical length before delivery (<2.0 cm), fetal non-cephalic presentation, and uteroplacental hypervascularity were significantly associated with massive PPH.
